data.one_liner: An advanced calendar widget with customizable views and rich API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a calendar widget supporting both month and week views, date selection, theme customization, and event indicators. It allows developers to manage calendar states through controllers and customize layouts and styles.
use_when: You need a flexible calendar widget that can switch between month and week views.
You want to customize calendar styling using theme data or explicit text styles.
You need to indicate specific dates with event markers.
avoid_when: You require complex scheduling or event management features beyond simple date indicators.
You do not need a visual calendar widget.
strengths: Supports switching between month and week views.
Rich widget customization and theme integration.
Event indication feature for specified dates.
weaknesses: Limited built-in event management beyond simple DateTimes list indicators.
Relies primarily on basic styling parameters rather than a modular architecture.
